body: An Aer Lingus Airbus A330-300, registration EI-EIL, operating flight EI-107 from Dublin to New York JFK (JFK), was en route at FL340 about 80nm northwest of Shannon on November 9, 2026, when the crew decided to return to Dublin. The aircraft landed safely on Dublin's runway 10L about one hour after departure. A listener on frequency reported the crew said their weather radar had failed twice: they had heard a loud clunking noise during climb out from Dublin and noticed some odour, the weather radar failed for a brief period and came back online, a burning smell occurred and quickly dissipated, and the weather radar failed a second time.

A United Boeing 787-9, registration N24993, operating flight UA-168 from Tel Aviv to Newark with 230 passengers and 13 crew, was en route at FL320 about 170nm east-southeast of Athens on November 9 when the crew decided to divert to Athens, reporting an unusual odour on board. The aircraft landed safely on Athens' runway 03R about 40 minutes later. The airline reported the aircraft diverted to Athens to address an odour in the cabin, and a replacement aircraft was being dispatched.

Two further incidents were reported on November 7. An Envoy Embraer ERJ-175, registration N225NN, operating flight AA-3618 from Cincinnati to Miami on behalf of American Airlines, landed on Miami's runway 12, slowed and turned off the runway when a nose wheel detached, and the aircraft stopped clear of the runway. The FAA reported: "LEFT NOSE WHEEL DETACHED WHILE EXITING RUNWAY." The aircraft was still on the ground in Miami about 43 hours after landing, according to the report. A THY Turkish Airlines Boeing 777-200 freighter, registration TC-LJL, operating freight flight TK-6040 from Maastricht to Istanbul, was climbing out of Maastricht's runway 21 when the crew reported the sound of an impact, some unknown object, during rotation. The aircraft stopped the climb at 5000 feet, the crew advised they were hearing unusual sounds, and the aircraft returned to Maastricht for a safe landing on runway 21 about 25 minutes after departure. Maastricht Airport reported the aircraft sustained a bird strike, and the aircraft was still on the ground in Maastricht about 22 hours after landing, according to the report. All four aircraft landed safely, and the reports did not mention injuries.
en.summary: Four aviation incidents were reported on November 7 and 9, 2026: an Aer Lingus A330 returned to Dublin after its weather radar failed twice, a United 787 diverted to Athens over an unusual odour, an Envoy E175 lost a nose wheel after landing in Miami, and a Turkish Airlines freighter returned to Maastricht after a bird strike. All four aircraft landed safely.
en.title: Safety roundup: Aer Lingus radar failure, United odour diversion, Envoy nose wheel loss and Turkish freighter bird strike

United flight UA-168, a Boeing 787-9 registered N24993 flying from Tel Aviv to Newark with 230 passengers and 13 crew, was en route at FL320 about 170nm east-southeast of Athens on November 9 when the crew diverted to Athens reporting an unusual odour, landing safely on runway 03R about 40 minutes later.
The airline reported the aircraft diverted to Athens to address an odour in the cabin and a replacement aircraft was being dispatched.

Envoy flight AA-3618, an Embraer ERJ-175 registered N225NN flying from Cincinnati to Miami, landed on Miami's runway 12 on November 7, 2026, slowed and turned off the runway when a nose wheel detached, and the aircraft stopped clear of the runway.
The FAA reported: "LEFT NOSE WHEEL DETACHED WHILE EXITING RUNWAY."

Turkish Airlines freight flight TK-6040, a Boeing 777-200 freighter registered TC-LJL flying from Maastricht to Istanbul, was climbing out of Maastricht's runway 21 on November 7 when the crew reported the sound of an impact during rotation, stopped the climb at 5000 feet, and returned for a safe landing on runway 21 about 25 minutes after departure.
Maastricht Airport reported the aircraft sustained a bird strike.

body: 愛爾蘭航空空中巴士A330-300（註冊編號EI-EIL）執行EI-107航班由都柏林飛往紐約甘迺迪機場（JFK），2026年11月9日在FL340高度、香農西北約80海里處，機組決定返航都柏林，起飛約1小時後安全降落都柏林10L跑道。據一名監聽頻率的聽眾回報，機組表示天氣雷達曾兩度故障：爬升離場時聽到巨大撞擊聲並聞到異味，天氣雷達短暫失效後恢復，隨後出現迅速消散的燒焦味，雷達再度失效。
聯合航空波音787-9（註冊編號N24993）執行UA-168航班由特拉維夫飛往紐華克，機上載有230名乘客與13名機組員，11月9日在FL320高度、雅典東南偏東約170海里處因機上異常氣味決定轉降雅典，約40分鐘後安全降落雅典03R跑道。航空公司表示，飛機轉降雅典是為處理機艙氣味，並正派遣替代飛機。

另有兩起事件發生於11月7日。特使航空Embraer ERJ-175（註冊編號N225NN）代表美國航空執行AA-3618航班由辛辛那提飛往邁阿密，降落邁阿密12號跑道後減速脫離跑道時前輪脫落，飛機停於跑道淨空處。美國聯邦航空總署通報稱：「LEFT NOSE WHEEL DETACHED WHILE EXITING RUNWAY.」（左前輪於脫離跑道時脫落。）據報導，飛機在降落約43小時後仍停留在邁阿密地面。土耳其航空波音777-200貨機（註冊編號TC-LJL）執行TK-6040貨運航班由馬斯垂克飛往伊斯坦堡，自馬斯垂克21號跑道爬升時，機組回報在抬輪時聽到撞擊聲（不明物體），爬升停止於5000英尺，機組表示聽到異常聲音，起飛約25分鐘後安全返回馬斯垂克21號跑道降落。馬斯垂克機場表示飛機遭遇鳥擊，據報導，飛機在降落約22小時後仍停留在馬斯垂克地面。4架飛機皆安全降落，相關報導未提及人員傷亡。
zh.summary: 2026年11月7日與9日通報4起飛安事件：愛爾蘭航空A330天氣雷達兩度故障返航都柏林、聯合航空787機上異味轉降雅典、特使航空E175降落邁阿密後前輪脫落、土耳其航空777貨機鳥擊返航馬斯垂克，4架飛機皆安全降落。
zh.title: 飛安彙整：愛爾蘭航空雷達故障返航、聯合航空異味轉降、特使航空前輪脫落、土航貨機鳥擊
